handoff_instructions: M2-T09 step 1/2 (call path only; message path still to do). Added: packages/domain/src/types.ts (Communication/Call/Message/CommunicationParticipant types + channel/direction/status/participant-role enums), packages/domain/src/schemas.ts (recordCallInput, recordMessageInput, updateCommunicationSummaryInput zod schemas + type exports — recordMessageInput/updateCommunicationSummaryInput are defined but not yet consumed), packages/domain/src/permissions.ts (new communication.read/communication.write permissions: read via STAFF_READ i.e. owner/office_admin/manager/accountant_readonly at code level though RLS on public.communications only allows owner/office_admin/manager; write via AUTOMATED_PERMISSIONS i.e. agent/integration/system), packages/domain/src/events.ts (communication.recorded/communication.updated event types). Added packages/core/src/rows.ts mappers (toCommunication/toCall/toMessage/toCommunicationParticipant + strArray helper). New packages/core/src/services/communications.ts implementing recordCall (idempotent upsert keyed on organization_id+provider+provider_conversation_id, folds a later lifecycle event like call.ended into the same row instead of duplicating; writes calls row via ON CONFLICT (communication_id); replaces participants with same-org validation via assertEntityInOrg; always records a business event + audit row) and getCommunication; exported from packages/core/src/index.ts. New packages/core/test/communications.test.ts (5 tests: create with event+audit, idempotent replay updates in place, cross-org participant rejected with NotFoundError, field_employee denied with ForbiddenError, getCommunication never returns another org's row). communications.ts is 180 lines already (close to the 200 hard limit) so message support was intentionally left out of this file this step to stay under the per-file limit — kept it IN_PROGRESS rather than cutting corners on tests. pnpm lint/typecheck/test all green (142 core tests incl. the 5 new ones). NEXT STEP: add recordMessage(ctx, input: RecordMessageInput) to communications.ts (same upsertEnvelope/setParticipants/finish helpers already in that file, mirror recordCall's ON CONFLICT (communication_id) pattern but on public.messages, remember media_urls must be JSON.stringify'd before binding — pg formats bare JS arrays as Postgres array literals, not JSON, which breaks the jsonb column), export it, add tests mirroring recordCall's (create+event/audit, idempotent replay, cross-org participant rejection), and consider whether updateCommunicationSummary/listCommunicationParticipants (schemas/rows already support them) are needed for M2-T10/T11 or can stay unused. Watch the 200-line hard limit on communications.ts across the two steps.
